title: Cohort-based release windows & orchestration playbook for runtime/console/api
creator: Priya Kapoor
description: Create a pragmatic playbook for cohort-based release windows that coordinates runtime, console, and API deliverables across multiple teams. The playbook should define: cohort boundaries (which customers/features move together), gating criteria per surface, clear rollout lanes (canary / progressive / emergency), scheduling constraints to avoid infra or region contention, and decision trees for rollbacks and escalations. This ticket collects templates, timeline heatmaps, stakeholder responsibilities, and a reproducible runbook for cross-surface launches.
acceptance_criteria: A reusable cohort window template (calendar + gating checklist) exists in Confluence
Rollout lanes defined with timing, SLO targets, and fallback policies for runtime, console, and API
Escalation path and postmortem ownership documented and linked to incident runbook
Simulation table showing no region/GPU capacity conflicts for the proposed cohort dates
Stakeholders (Eng, SRE, Product, Design, Customer Success) have reviewed and signed off
tasks: Draft cohort window matrix and proposed dates (PM)
Map feature-to-surface dependencies and minimal viable cohorts (Eng + PM)
Inventory infra constraints (SRE) and mark blackout dates
Create gating checklist per surface (QA, performance, security, telemetry)
Run a dry-run tabletop with sample cohort and simulate rollback scenario
Publish final playbook in Confluence and share in #launch-orchestration
risks: Infra contention: multiple cohorts overlapping in the same region leading to GPU capacity shortage
Hidden cross-surface dependency: console UI change requires runtime schema update after cutoff
Rollout velocity mismatch: runtime canary finishes faster than console rollout causing inconsistent UX
Customer-impacting regression discovered late in canary window
Blocked by external partner release or compliance approval
decisions: Adopt cohort windows sized to ~3-5 features per cohort to limit blast radius (decision date: 2026-02-27)
Primary gating order: QA signoff -> performance benchmark -> telemetry validation -> security scan
Use region-aware scheduling: stagger cohorts across regions when GPU reservations exceed 70%
Rollbacks default to runtime fallback variant when API contract is preserved; console UI toggles to legacy route
